title: Digging Deeper: How Brandeis Students Learn Archaeology Without Leaving Campus
text:
How do you teach hands-on archaeology during a pandemic? At Brandeis University, professors got creative—turning campus spaces into immersive micro-sites where students learn to excavate, analyze, and interpret history through model artifacts and buried clues. In this innovative learning experience, students become archaeologists, storytellers, and data interpreters all at once.

title: Brandeis University no longer supporting pro-Palestinian student group
text:
Nearly one month after Hamas’s attack on Israel, Brandeis University announced the decision to no longer support the campus chapter of the National Students for Justice in Palestine. Some students say the move makes them feel safer, while others say it’s a violation of their right to free speech.
